questions.Q1: On the low-RTT VPS route, does callback frame excess retain historical p99 and >10/20ms episode tails, or approach zero? Compare the frozen effective-route fit; attribution remains conditional on clean collector and near-constant path.
questions.Q2: Retest adopted motion/mass gates, reverse same-snake mass/motion ordering and repeat prey-correction gaps on server and receipt clocks. Which historical exceptions persist? Spawn admission is out of scope.

officialList.selection: The two owner-named IPs must be active port-444 entries in the fresh official list. No substitution.

allocation: One forage client per endpoint, <=2 sockets total including CONNECTING, independent endpoint cancellation. Three restarted600s rounds, first two development and third heldout; original30s round spacing. A normal requested post-death life end rejoins only after the old socket closes.
attemptBudget: One bounded restart of the original three ten-minute rounds. A socket error or close not following this socket's collector-requested post-death close stops only that endpoint for the rest of the run, without retry/reconnect/substitution. After deathObservation.closeRequestedAt is set by the base collector before ws.close(), the following error/close (including1006) is retained but treated as that life ending; the base collector may rejoin. Reset intent for the next socket. Process/watchdog failures stop the coordinator without replacement.

resources.network: host avoids Docker bridge/NAT for timing fidelity. Gauge uses --network none.
resources.hostChanges: No packages, services, system config or existing containers/volumes/directories. Only ~/slither-capture-20261026/. Remove scratch and newly pulled image after verified copy.
resources.localCpu: At most two logical CPUs; Windows analysis affinity4,5, numerical library threads1. No Rust build.

telemetry.clock: performance.now() raw receive/send callbacks, before decode, per-setup cumulative elapsed headers. Callback time is not kernel arrival.
telemetry.stallGauge: 1ms high-resolution timer: actual gap and gap minus1 lateness maxima; monitorEventLoopDelay resolution1; GC/receive maxima. Every second, no integer-ms histogram decisions.
telemetry.cleanMask: Exclude telemetry interval [since-100ms,until+100ms] if timer lateness>5ms, loop max>6ms, any GC>5ms, receive cost>5ms or backpressureWrites increases. No gauge coverage means unknown/excluded. Pair intervals crossing any mask are excluded. Threshold fixed, never relaxed for load.
telemetry.justification: Linux 1ms hrtimer ordinary sleep is about1ms, unlike Windows coarse timer dispatch. A >5ms extra delay can contaminate the >10ms target; the conservative gauge did flag occasional 6.8ms preflight gaps. Those are excluded rather than moving the threshold.
telemetry.load: Every second: host /proc/loadavg and aggregate /proc/stat (steal delta field8/total delta), own cgroup cpu.stat usage and throttle deltas, process CPU/memory, GC, gzip/output queues and socket bufferedAmount. Other services load is a covariate, never permission to loosen gates.

split: Whole round3 at both endpoints held out. No game timing/scheduler analysis of it until development.json is saved, its hash sealed in local analysis-seal.json and committed analysis-source pins match. Only runtime/status/integrity checks before that. No fitting or question changes.

network.metric: Reuse historical Theil-Sen of p1 offsets in5s bins, centered +/-10s minimum, per-setup after1s burn-in, >=1000frames and>=30s. Retain slopes, raw spans, line-only residuals, full and clean excess p50/p90/p99/p99.9; raw game RTT. Future-dependent floor is offline only.
network.episodes: Contiguous excess>10/20ms runs per eligible setup; counts, clean exposure seconds, runs/s, peak/duration/surrounding bracket distributions and censored edges. Single-frame duration0 is a lower bound, not a physical pause duration. Bursts: adjacent receipt gaps<1ms.
network.eligibility: Each heldout endpoint >=300 clean eligible seconds and>=80% clean/full eligible exposure, complete gzip/terminal/protocol19/source integrity. Otherwise attribution is inconclusive; report all unfiltered results.
network.classification: Per eligible heldout endpoint: near-zero if clean p99<=3ms AND >10ms runs<=0.05/s; persistent if clean p99>=8ms OR >10ms runs>=0.25/s; intermediate otherwise. Both endpoints reported, primary inference on low endpoint. Descriptive thresholds, not population confidence or proof of shared server scheduling.
network.comparison: Compare to #108 full batch p99 (low57.5/66.5/29.9ms; second22.7/21.2/110.2ms) and network-path heldout pooled p99=9.21ms, >10ms runs0.351/s. Exact six frozen fit parameters below, same schedules and three seeds; no refit.
network.fitGates: Report p50/p90 within max(0.5ms,15% observed), p99 within20%, burst fraction error<=0.005, ACF at10/50/100/500/1000ms error<=0.10 for each seed. Failure rejects transfer, not the historical data. No adoption in this PR.

scheduler.unit: Consecutive same-entity reports within same setup/connection/uninterrupted appearance, reset on s or y appearance/removal; repeat j only, entry-to-first excluded. All full and fully clean intervals retained.
scheduler.metrics: Server/receipt gap summaries, motion<35ms and<42ms, standalone h<100ms and<105ms, same-frame same-snake mass(h/r)-before-motion and reverse counts. Repeat j<300/<333/<210 and>500ms, split whether previous/current speed exactly11, max and raw witnesses. Frame index0-based over post-setup frames retained in order; pin compressed archive SHA256. No intervals across known reincarnations.
scheduler.gates: At least one clean server-clock motion<35ms rejects literal wire42ms minimum; h<100ms rejects literal wire105ms minimum; reverse pair rejects absolute mass-before-motion order; j>500ms with intervening traffic rejects bounded333/210ms correction, short gaps split by speed11 constrain guard. Absence is sample-limited, not confirmation of hidden ticks. Receipt-only short gaps with server gaps above gates are burst-compression cases.
scheduler.limits: No official physics tick ID, hidden dirty events or kernel arrival clock. A changing send-header clock can violate wire minima without violating an internal tick gate. Independent endpoints cannot establish cross-client shared-delay coupling.

authorization: Explicitly authorized second continuation after raw audit showed wrappers stopped on requested first-death closes. Prior attempts stay quarantined; never modify raw bytes.
priorAttemptCorrection: Full raw-stream audit shows all three prior stopped-client sequences had a death packet and collector close request before socket-error/end/1006, all in life1. Original second was sibling-aborted without death. Prior unusability conclusion withdrawn; a block is not indicated. This ordering does not identify the cause of socket-error.
originalAttempt: Original vps-copy and first continuation/vps-copy remain separate and quarantined; never concatenate their epochs into this second-continuation/vps-copy.
analysisRouting: analyze_second_continuation.py uses unchanged analyze.py/timing.py metrics and gates, verifies frozen source pins, saves development and a seal before heldout inspection. Existing receipt-only witnesses use the same declared thresholds. No fitting or new questions.
privacyRules: Public artifacts describe only a remote Linux ARM64 VM, optionally four vCPUs, generic image/caps/networking, official endpoint timings and load/steal covariates. Keep machine identity, private address/hostname, account and absolute remote host paths out of public files and PR text. Scan public content before every push; use new commits only and preserve frozen history.
